from jinja2 import Environment
import pytest

def test_custom_filter_with_async_true():
    env = Environment(enable_async=True)
    env.filters.update({'add_two': lambda x, y: [i + y for i in x]})

    template = env.from_string("{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}")
    assert template.render(a=dict(b=[1, 2, 3])) == "6"
